acceptance: Final membership, capability profiles, size vectors, effective weights, concurrency points, cache/warmup policy, and numerical qualification thresholds are versioned and immutable.
Five fresh end-to-end reference runs pass every preregistered correctness, resource, locality, client-headroom, thermal, timeout, and variance gate.
The physical reference identity, hardware-unit continuity policy, and every software, hardware, data, translated-SQL, configuration, and manifest hash are published.
Policy declares how benchmark-specific tuning is attested, labeled, compared, and admitted or excluded from default rankings.
Reference replacement and score compatibility distinguish proportional equivalent recalibration from non-proportional major-version changes.
Every ADR acceptance gate has linked evidence and the ADR status is updated through review.
context: Implements the proposed cross-benchmark score architecture. Preserve official TPC metrics as separate outputs. Numerical weights, size vectors, concurrency points, thresholds, and the M4 reference remain pilot hypotheses until methodology freeze.
description: Resolve the ADR's pilot hypotheses, freeze methodology version 1, and qualify the physical reference vector. Update the ADR from Proposed only after all gates have objective evidence.
